newsitem.title: USA: United Vanguard files for 1.8 mln offering.
newsitem.headline: United Vanguard files for 1.8 mln offering.

text.p: United Vanguard Homes Inc said on Wednesday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer 1.8 million common shares and 1.8 million common stock purchase warrants.
The company said in a statement that until the offer was completed, one warrant had to be purchased with each share.
The shares and warrants would trade separately immediately after the offering, it said.
United Vanguard said it was also offering in a separate prospectus $12.5 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior secured notes due 2006.
The offering would be managed by Janney Montgomery Scott Inc and Rodman & Renshaw Inc, it said.
The company's main shareholder, Vanguard Ventures Inc, granted the underwriters an option to buy up to 270,000 additional warrants, to cover any over-allotments, the company said.
